acceptance.given: Orphan validation is run against the complete frozen atomic-obligation set and its exact-cover graph.

oracle.expected: Validation reports zero orphaned atomic obligations and rejects any uncovered obligation.
forbidden: Validation permits one or more orphaned atomic obligations.
A zero-orphan result is inferred without checking the complete set.
oracle.observable: The validator output contains an explicit zero-orphan count or status tied to the frozen atomic-obligation set.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run exact-cover orphan validation with at least one uncovered atomic obligation; validation must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure exact-cover validation computes the complete atomic-obligation set and emits a zero-orphan result only when every obligation is covered bidirectionally.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve validator result schema and existing exact-cover semantics; rollback only orphan-detection logic.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unvalidated atomic-obligation graph -> exact-cover validation -> explicit zero-orphan verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator exits successfully only with an explicit zero-orphan result for the complete frozen set; any orphan causes failure.

acceptance.given: A replay or evaluation request supplies a target classified as illegal by the Toolchain target policy.

oracle.expected: The operation is rejected or blocked before any target-dependent work, with no illegal target accepted or used.
forbidden: Silently normalizing or substituting the illegal target.
oracle.observable: The command result is a deterministic rejection or blocked status and contains no successful target-use record.

acceptance.then: The illegal-target condition is rejected and no target-dependent operation proceeds.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the illegal-target negative probe; the validator must observe rejection and fail if the operation proceeds or substitutes a target.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce fail-closed target-policy validation so illegal targets are rejected before replay, inspection, or any target-dependent operation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing replay route and error contract; rollback only illegal-target gating.

slice_hint.state_transition: Illegal target supplied -> policy classification -> deterministic rejection with no target use.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No target-dependent operation executes unless target policy marks the target legal; illegal input yields rejection or blocked result.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded and includes its target binding record.

oracle.expected: Independent verification recomputes or checks the target identity and records that verification in the successful Replay Result.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result without independent target verification.
oracle.observable: Replay evidence contains a target-verification record produced independently of the replay success claim.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or invalidate the independent target-verification record from a successful Replay Result; acceptance must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful replay acceptance to independently verify target identity and bind the resulting verification evidence to the Replay Result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve successful Replay Result schema while requiring the existing target-verification evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Replay succeeds -> independent target identity check -> verified Replay Result or rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A success verdict is emitted only when independent target verification passes and is recorded.
